name: Drata
summary: Drata sells Foundation, Advanced and Enterprise compliance tiers. Foundation covers up to 50 employees and one pre-mapped framework such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001. All three tiers include automated evidence collection and an Audit Hub for auditor communication. Prices are not published.

evidence.capability: framework templates such as soc 2 and iso 27001

facts.text: The Foundation compliance tier covers up to 50 full-time employees and one pre-mapped framework, limited to SOC 2, ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials, HIPAA or GDPR.
Advanced and Enterprise tiers include any available framework, and additional frameworks, user access reviews and custom frameworks are sold as add-ons on some plans.
Automated evidence collection is listed as included in all three compliance tiers.
Drata describes its Audit Hub as the place to centralize communication with your auditor and store documentation, and lists it in all three compliance tiers.
The pricing page shows no dollar amounts and no free trial. The only free item is the first 25 approved domains for the Trust Center.

plans.name: Foundation
plans.notes: Up to 50 FTEs and one pre-mapped framework. Every plan button leads to a demo request

hiddenCosts: Additional frameworks, user access reviews, Workspaces and custom frameworks are add-ons on some plans.
